QuestInfo.1: You can earn bonus EXP with the help of #b#p9010010##k's magic when you hunt monsters. The magic will last until September 2nd.\r\nHunt #r#M9891##k and earn #r#x9891# #kbonus hunting EXP.

0.0: I did it! I finally did it. I perfected a new magic! I'm so awesome. I mean, that much is obvious, right?

quest.0: \r\nWith my new magic, if you hunt #r#M9891##k you'll earn #r#x9891# #kbonus hunting EXP. To choose a different monster, talk to me after you forfeit the quest in the Quest window by pressing the hotkey Q.
